RE: Account reference: ACC-993085

Dear [CONSUMER NAME],

Re: Dispute of Account ACC-993085

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter regarding the account referenced above. You have disputed the debt as not being yours. We understand that you have requested validation of the debt, which we have not provided.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with validation of the debt. However, based on the record, we have not received a request for validation from you.

We will investigate this matter further and review the account information. We will also verify the identity of the original creditor, Liberty Credit Corp, and confirm the charge-off date of 2023-06-03.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this debt further. If you believe that the debt is not yours, you may continue to dispute it. We will provide you with a written acknowledgement of your dispute and will update our records accordingly.

Sincerely,

[AGENCY NAME]

Note: I have not included any specific date in the letter as it was not provided in the record.
